thread:
sam: FYI: hotwire feature rollout canary (region-eu-2) started seeing 5xx spike ~3m ago, latency up ~2x. auto-rollout didn't kick yet. tagging oncall.
ops-incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03017-heat1 by sam — Severity: P2 — Affects: hosted inference / text-gen — runbook: deploy-rollback.
maria: I'm on it, looking at metrics now. any customer-facing errors reported?
sam: No PagerDuty alerts from customers yet, but internal SLOs tripped. examples in logs: `InferenceBackendError: kv-cache timeout` repeated.
lee: I'm seeing increased 502s from model-proxy in eu2; tailing proxy logs now. Could be a model binary mismatch on that canary pool.
jordan: Is this the hotwire quantization change? We rolled the q4a variant at 09:12.
sam: yes q4a-hotwire. rollout config: 5% canary -> 25% -> 100%. currently stuck at 5% but errors climbed.
maria: ok prioritize safety. can someone flip the safety flag to pause the rollout? we should stop more traffic going to that variant.
lee: grabbing flag console. quick toggle via API:
```
POST https://flags.internal.redwood/api/v1/toggle
body: {"flag":"hotwire.release.q4a","state":"paused","actor":"maria"}
```
lee: doing the toggle now.
ops-incident-bot: Feature flag hotwire.release.q4a set to PAUSED by lee at 1719505550.
maria: good. now we need to decide rollback vs debug. if it's binary mismatch we should roll back variant to previous build (q4a -> q4b-stable).
jordan: team prefers rollback for safety and to restore SLAs; sign-off from product to avoid user regressions: @jordan approve?
jordan: approved. revert to q4b-stable on canary and resume health checks. :thumbsup:
sam: I'm going to trigger the canary revert procedure. steps: 1) pin routing to q4b-stable for canary group, 2) drain q4a nodes, 3) monitor 5xx and latency for 15m.
lee: I'll handle routing pin. running the CLI command:
```
redwoodctl rollout set --pool eu2-canary --model hotwire:q4b-stable --force --note "revert after 5xx spike"
```
lee: command returned: accepted, job-id 98321.
ops-incident-bot: Rollout job 98321 started.
maria: notify traffic team to avoid any automated promotion tasks. @traffic-automation please hold promotions for 30m.
sam: pinged traffic-automation. They acked.
lee: draining q4a instances now. small hiccup: one instance failed to drain due to stuck websocket sessions — killing connection gracefully.
lee: drain progress: 4/5 drained, last one in terminating state.
ops-incident-bot: Drain heartbeat: last_progress 1719505900, instances_remaining 1.
maria: good status. any customer impact seen now?
sam: errors down by ~60% since flag pause and routing pin, but still above baseline. monitoring 5m windows.
jordan: scoped list of affected customers in CRM shows no high tier errors for now; keep an eye.
lee: final instance terminated and replaced with q4b-stable. new proxy metrics show 5xxs back down to baseline.
ops-incident-bot: Rollout job 98321 completed at 1719506102.
maria: let's run smoke tests: hit /health and run a few generation requests against eu2.
sam: smoke run results: 20/20 OK, latency back to normal.
lee: checking logs for residual kv-cache errors — only a couple timestamps around the spike, no ongoing.
jordan: prep a short customer note? Ops wants a PSR if any customers were impacted. I don't think we need a public incident page, but capture in postmortem.
maria: agree. capture timeline and root cause hypothesis (binary mismatch under certain seq lengths with q4a quant schedule). assign postmortem owner.
sam: I'll own the postmortem and draft within 24h. action items: 1) block automated promotion for hotwire until additional regression tests, 2) add canary seq-length fuzz tests, 3) make the flag toggle path more discoverable in runbook.
lee: will add a guard in rollout orchestration to prevent q-variant promotions if post-quant test fails.
ops-incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03017-heat1 status: RESOLVED at 1719506289 by maria.
maria: closing the channel, thanks all for quick response. :heart:
sam: thanks — filing postmortem and linking to this thread.
jordan: great work, team.
